description.value:
At 6th level, the blue mage can invoke a creature to use its spell-like or supernatural ability. The blue mage must know what the creature possesses for abilities by using the scan ability. If a creature has more than one ability, the blue mage can decide which one she wants the creature to use.

The creature gets a Will save (DC 10 + half of the blue mage's level + her Intelligence modifier) to negate this ability, if it fails, on its next turn, it will use its ability. This ability has a range of 60 feet and requires a move action which doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. This is a mind-affecting effect.

At 12th level, the blue mage's ability to invoke a creature to use its abilities improves. The blue mage can use this ability as a swift action.
